sections.name: PageHeader
sections.description: 5-row label/value header box. Column widths: 40% label, 60% bold value.

sections.name: Detail
sections.description: Large bordered box filling remaining page height. First row: 4 static column headers (Sender Ref, Histo Ref, Block Ref, Test) in 7pt grey text, evenly spaced at 25% each. Second row: QCText paragraph spanning all columns.

sections.name: PageFooter
sections.description: Single row outside bordered boxes, at the bottom of the page: CreatedBy left-aligned, DateCreated right-aligned. No border.

notes: Metadata extracted from visual reference (docs/pdf-op-compare/QCNote-image.png), DataSet specification provided by developer, and QCNotes.aspx.vb / QCNoteForm.aspx.vb calling-page inspection.
complexity: low — single table named 'Header', no sub-reports, no running totals.
DateCreated is pre-formatted as 'dd MMMM yyyy' by the DataSetBuilder — no date parsing required in the renderer.

Column headers (Sender Ref, Histo Ref, Block Ref, Test) are static pre-printed labels only. These columns were populated by a Crystal Reports sub-report in the legacy system; they are not present in the modern DataSet and are rendered as static label row only.
runtimeParadigm: modern (explicit) — srcFolder: src/ — renderer placed at src/Histo.Reporting/Reports/QCNoteRenderer.cs
